definitions.explanation: The way or method of doing something. Often used with verbs to describe how something is done.

examples.english: It can't be helped. / There's nothing that can be done.

examples.japanese: {仕方|しかた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please teach me how to do it.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{仕方|しかた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}からなくて→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: I'm struggling because I don't know how to do it.

notes:
{仕方|しかた} means 'way of doing' and is often combined with verb stems.

COMMON PATTERN: [Verb stem] + {方|かた}
- ⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧: way of using
- ⟦{読|よ}み{方|かた}→読み方：14269_yomikata⟧: way of reading
- ⟦{書|か}き{方|かた}→書き方：13054_kakikata⟧: way of writing
- ⟦{作|つく}り{方|かた}→作り方：noentry⟧: way of making

KEY EXPRESSION:
{仕方|しかた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ / {仕方|しかた}⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: It can't be helped, there's no way around it. This is one of the most important Japanese expressions, reflecting acceptance of situations beyond one's control.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧: method (more formal)
- ⟦やり{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧: way of doing (casual)
